Moses' command that no leavened bread be eaten in connection with the exodus from Egypt
The requirement for the Feast of Unleavened Bread and to eat unleavened bread for seven days

The law requiring the Feast of Unleavened Bread and eating unleavened bread for seven days
Moses repeats the prohibition against eating leavened bread and that no leaven shall be seen in all the land for seven days
